item.title: Destination Frontiers: Provocations & Futures
item.content:encoded:
This special article collection in the Journal of Destination Marketing & Management invites scholarly contributions that explore emerging frontiers and future directions in destination marketing and management. The collection seeks thought-provoking work that challenges conventional thinking and proposes innovative perspectives on how destinations evolve and compete in changing landscapes.
